quote: We train and evaluate ASR and ST models on MuST-C v1.0, which contains parallel speech-to-text data with English (en) as source language and 8 target text languages, namely Dutch (nl), French (fr), German (de), Italian (it), Portuguese (pt), Romanian (ro), Russian (ru), and Spanish (es).
